$description: CODE-OWNED. Not in Figma, and not overwritten by `npm run sync:figma`. Breakpoints are a Bootstrap contract, not a design decision; containers are a code concern the Figma file has no equivalent for.

breakpoint.$description: MUST match Bootstrap 5 exactly (576/768/992/1200/1400) so Bootstrap utilities and Tailwind variants agree. A mismatch here produces bugs that take days to find. Figma has no breakpoint variables, so this stays here by design.

container.$description: Max content widths used by docs/layouts/. 'prose' is the readable measure for long-form content (~70ch).

radius.$description: Figma now exports a radius scale (rounded-0 through rounded-3, rounded-circle, ucsd-8px). Only 'pill' is code-owned because Figma has no pill equivalent.
